description: Use this when the user asks how to say something in Emirati Arabic (the spoken dialect of the UAE, not formal Arabic), or wants Emirati phrases about a topic. Search in English, Easy Latin or Arabic. Returns up to 10 phrases, each with Arabic script, an easy Latin spelling, the English meaning, who it's said to when that matters, a real recording where there is one, and a link to its page.
